import numpy as np

    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]

        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2

        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Explicitly set the template to use dvisvgm with latex to avoid DVI conversion issues
        # on systems where the default PDF->SVG path is broken or not supported.
        tex_template = TexTemplate()
        tex_template.compiler = "latex"

        lecture_lines = [
            "We need to sum specific coefficients.",
            "Roots of unity form regular polygons.",
            "[Asset: RootsUnitCircle] shows these complex pointers.",
            "Multiplying by ω acts as a filter.",
            "This sieve cancels out unwanted terms."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Geometry of Selection: Complex Roots of Unity", lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Visualizing the unit circle
        circle = Circle(radius=1.5, color="#FFFFFF")
        self.place_in_area(circle, "B2", "E5")
        self.play(Create(circle))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00CCFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Roots of unity (n=3)
        roots = VGroup(*[Dot(point=1.5 * np.array([np.cos(2*PI*k/3), np.sin(2*PI*k/3), 0])) for k in range(3)])
        roots.set_color("#FF3399")
        self.place_in_area(roots, "B2", "E5")
        self.play(FadeIn(roots))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF3399")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Asset Placeholder representation
        vector = Line(start=ORIGIN, end=roots[0].get_center(), color="#FF3399")
        label = MathTex(r"\omega", color="#FF3399", tex_template=tex_template).next_to(vector.get_end(), UP)
        self.play(Create(vector), Write(label))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFFF66")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Projection
        projection = Line(start=vector.get_end(), end=[vector.get_end()[0], 0, 0], color="#00CCFF")
        self.play(Create(projection))
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#00CCFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Sieve logic
        self.play(Indicate(roots), run_time=2)
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#33FF33")
